openai.name: OpenAI
openai.freePlanNote: No free API tier; usage is pay-as-you-go per token or call (File Search storage includes 1 GB free).

products.name: GPT-5.5 (Responses API)
products.tagline: Flagship reasoning and chat model, billed per input and output token

meters.label: Input tokens
meters.perRequestNote: prompt tokens per chat call (uncached)

meters.label: Cached input tokens
meters.perRequestNote: prompt-cache hit tokens per call

meters.label: Output tokens
meters.perRequestNote: completion tokens, including reasoning, per call

products.name: GPT-5.4 mini
products.tagline: Small, low-cost model for classification, extraction and simple replies

meters.label: Input tokens
meters.perRequestNote: prompt tokens per call

meters.label: Cached input tokens
meters.perRequestNote: prompt-cache hit tokens per call

meters.label: Output tokens
meters.perRequestNote: completion tokens per call

products.name: Embeddings (text-embedding-3)
products.tagline: Vector embeddings for search and RAG, billed per input token

meters.label: text-embedding-3-small tokens
meters.perRequestNote: tokens embedded per call (one query or chunk)

meters.label: text-embedding-3-large tokens
meters.perRequestNote: tokens embedded per call when using the large model

products.name: Image generation (gpt-image-2)
products.tagline: Text-to-image and image editing, billed per image input and output token

meters.label: Input tokens (text + image)
meters.perRequestNote: prompt tokens per generated image

meters.label: Image output tokens
meters.perRequestNote: approx. output tokens for one 1024x1024 medium-quality image

products.name: Realtime API (gpt-realtime-2.1)
products.tagline: Low-latency speech-to-speech sessions, billed per audio and text token

meters.label: Audio input tokens
meters.perRequestNote: approx. 10 s of user audio per turn

meters.label: Audio output tokens
meters.perRequestNote: approx. 10 s of spoken reply per turn

meters.label: Text input tokens
meters.perRequestNote: instructions and context tokens per turn

meters.label: Text output tokens
meters.perRequestNote: transcript tokens per turn

products.name: Speech (TTS and transcription)
products.tagline: gpt-4o-mini-tts text-to-speech and gpt-4o-transcribe speech-to-text

meters.label: TTS audio output tokens
meters.perRequestNote: approx. 15 s of synthesized speech

meters.label: TTS text input tokens
meters.perRequestNote: text tokens sent for synthesis

meters.label: gpt-4o-transcribe audio
meters.perRequestNote: minutes of audio transcribed per call (15 s)

products.name: Built-in tools (web search, file search)
products.tagline: Hosted tools for the Responses API, billed per call and per GB stored

meters.label: Web search tool calls
meters.perRequestNote: fraction of user requests that trigger a web search

meters.label: File search tool calls
meters.perRequestNote: fraction of user requests that run a vector-store search

meters.label: File search vector storage
meters.perRequestNote: time-based, not per request; 1 GB free (30 GB-days a month)

shopify.name: Shopify
shopify.freePlanNote: No free production plan. Development stores are free to build on; paid plans include the Storefront API, Functions, Flow and Oxygen at no extra charge.

products.name: Storefront API
products.tagline: GraphQL API for products, collections, cart and search

meters.label: Storefront API requests
meters.perRequestNote: one GraphQL call per end-user request; free, no fixed rate limit for buyer traffic (tokenless queries capped at complexity 1,000)

products.name: Shopify Functions
products.tagline: WebAssembly extensions for discounts, delivery, payment and validation at checkout

meters.label: Function executions
meters.perRequestNote: one run per cart or checkout event; not metered, limited to 11M instructions, 128 kB input, 20 kB output; custom-app functions need Plus

products.name: Hydrogen on Oxygen
products.tagline: Shopify-hosted edge runtime for Hydrogen storefronts, included with paid plans

meters.label: Oxygen worker requests
meters.perRequestNote: no per-request or bandwidth charge; 128 MB memory, 400 ms startup limit; 1 public environment (25 on Plus)

products.name: Checkout and Shopify Payments
products.tagline: Hosted checkout; card processing fees per order

meters.label: Online card rate (Basic, 2.9% of order value)
meters.perRequestNote: order value in USD per completed checkout; Grow 2.7%, Advanced 2.5%

meters.label: Online card fixed fee
meters.perRequestNote: per completed online transaction

products.name: Admin GraphQL API and webhooks
products.tagline: Backend API for orders, products and customers; rate-limited by query cost, not billed

meters.label: Admin API query cost points
meters.perRequestNote: free, leaky-bucket limited to 100 points/s (Standard), 200 (Advanced), 1,000 (Plus)

meters.label: Webhook deliveries
meters.perRequestNote: event pushes per end-user request; free, delivery not guaranteed

products.name: Shopify Flow
products.tagline: No-code automation; free on Basic, Grow, Advanced and Plus

meters.label: Workflow runs
meters.perRequestNote: workflow runs per end-user request; free, capped by the plan's API limits

netlify.name: Netlify
netlify.freePlanNote: Free plan: a shared pool of 300 credits a month (about $2 of usage) across bandwidth, compute, web requests and production deploys; projects pause when credits run out.

products.name: Netlify Functions
products.tagline: Serverless, scheduled and background functions billed by GB-hour plus web requests

meters.label: Compute
meters.perRequestNote: 1 GB memory for about 0.2 s per invocation; 10 credits per GB-hour

meters.label: Web requests (invocations)
meters.perRequestNote: each invocation is a web request; 2 credits per 10k

products.name: Edge Functions
products.tagline: Deno-based functions at the CDN edge, billed as web requests

meters.label: Edge invocations (web requests)
meters.perRequestNote: one invocation per request; cached responses not counted

products.name: Netlify Blobs
products.tagline: Key/value object store for unstructured data; objects up to 5 GB

meters.label: Blob reads served (bandwidth)
meters.perRequestNote: approx. 10 kB read per request, metered as bandwidth (20 credits per GB); no standalone storage rate is published

products.name: Image CDN
products.tagline: On-demand image transformation and format negotiation on the CDN

meters.label: Image bandwidth
meters.perRequestNote: approx. 200 kB of images per page view; 20 credits per GB

products.name: Netlify Forms
products.tagline: Built-in HTML form handling with spam filtering; free and unlimited

meters.label: Form submissions
meters.perRequestNote: submissions per end-user request; free since April 2026

products.name: Netlify Identity
products.tagline: Hosted auth (signup, login, OAuth, invite-only) at no additional cost

meters.label: Auth API calls (web requests)
meters.perRequestNote: unlimited active users; auth calls count as web requests

products.name: CDN bandwidth and web requests
products.tagline: Static hosting metered by bandwidth and web requests; builds not metered

meters.label: Bandwidth
meters.perRequestNote: approx. 500 kB served per page view; 20 credits per GB

meters.label: Web requests
meters.perRequestNote: page view, API call, asset or redirect; 2 credits per 10k
